notes.title: Muted not Silenced Update: Character Abilities and Pills
notes.content:
The Muted not Silenced Update is here!

Make sure you have enough time to read and let the updates this month sink in... We watched you early Alpha players play, we listened to you, and read your suggestions, and we hope the update satisfies your expectations:


ːsteamthumbsupː [b]Abilities...[/b]
They are shaken to their core
1- Your character unlocks abilities based on your Fighter mastery, and no longer based on your Deck mastery (being phased out)

2- No more fusing. Abilities level up automatically with each kill. Random abilities on your deck are selected.

3- Moreover, you gain pills, leaves, and powder (let's call them essences!) with each kill, they allow you to further level up the abilities you chose, giving you some level of strategy and flexibility in planning as essences can be used on abilities that are not in your deck, and which you may want to groom for later on or for different modes

4- You don't have to collect abilities level ups from loot anymore, you automatically gain them at the end of each battle, whenever your character dies or leaves the battle.

5- Of course, this now spills over to guilds: donations are made of essences! Your guildmates may have essences they don't need but which you do. This way, your guild becomes a sort of a meta-character on its own, if you chose complementary paths, the essences you collect will be complementary.


ːsteamthumbsupː [b]Player-owned Crafting stations...[/b]
Took a while to prepare, but a must in a player-driven economy.

1- Each town now has land plots available for bidding by players. Bids reset every month.

2- Land plot owners can build the crafting station they desire.

3- Each crafting action done at a crafting station consumes figs deposited by the owner. The owner decides the figs to coins conversion ratio, which drives the price of crafting.

4- Figs consumed by each crafting stations are pre-determined by the system.


ːsteamthumbsupː [b]New Town Art...[/b]
Arzol, Hermelis, and Akaria all got a new layer of make up. Take your time to do some tourism and hope you enjoy them!

ːsteamthumbsupː [b]New Abilities Associated with the Eclipse Charm...[/b]
Driving a totally new way to look at your deck's strengths and weaknesses

ːsteamthumbsupː [b]Mounts durability now decays...[/b]
The cycle of life

ːsteamthumbsupː [b]Bugs and QoL...[/b]
Many, many, many bugs squashed and improvements to QoL

We are at your disposal for any suggestions.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Devlog #22 - Farming Labs, Tribe Updates, New Items, QOL Updates and Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
Greetings Crafters!
We’ve got [b]new [/b]features, tribe upgrades, and [b]tons[/b] of fixes to make your journey better than ever. 
Check out the details below:

[h1]Patch Notes - Update Highlights[/h1]
[h2]Farming Labs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Introducing our latest feature: Farming Labs! Here, you can seed atoms and watch them grow into full ethers or figs, which can be used to craft special items.
[/list][h2]Road to Sovereign[/h2]
[list]
[*] Gather resources, defeat monsters and flagged players, and hold control points while flagged to earn seals.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332806/fcffc6e8fe4a5bdd457e4415ebf937014f566988.png[/img]

[h2]New Mountain Charm Added[/h2]
[list][*] Collected Arzol Seals can now be used as crafting ingredients for the new Mountain Charm.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332806/b3a4679a048aa58c608cbf64d892940568c8af19.png[/img]

[h2]Tribes Expansion[/h2]
[h3]Ranks[/h3]
[list][*] New tribe ranking system! Increase your rank by gaining tribe points and earn unique titles, which will be displayed on your inspect screen.[/list][h3]Tribe Points[/h3]
[list][*] Tribe Points (formerly Flag Points) are earned through battling monsters, gathering, defeating field bosses, and collecting interval rewards from field bosses.
[*] Your rank will increase as you hit specific milestones, unlocking new titles.[/list][h3]Tribe Leaderboards[/h3][list][*] Leaderboards are now available for players filtered by tribe, as well as for the top 3 tribes as a whole.[/list][h3]Tribe Join Rules Update[/h3][list]
[*] Seals earned while flagged now belong to your tribe.
[*] Controlling outposts grants specific seals.
[*] Tribe switching cooldown is 7 days with a penalty of 30% to your rank points.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332806/a34dff2d8609e644c4ce32e3b3389af9b52af0d1.png[/img]

[h2]Mission Fixes[/h2][list]
[*] [b]"Collect Loot" Mission[/b]: Resolved issue where collecting a completed mission reward incorrectly completed another mission.
[*] [b]"Refine Fabric"[/b] Mission: Reset bug after refining 16 fabrics is now fixed.
[*] [b]"Craft T3 Weapon"[/b] Mission: Fixed cases where the mission was marked as complete before crafting the weapon.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332806/ec19d04990cf2df1a954121d56ed289ce453a627.png[/img]

[h2]Screen Resolution Enhancements[/h2][list]
[*] [b]Mouse Cursor and Screen Resolution[/b]: Cursor is no longer affected by different screen resolutions.
[*] [b]Game and Battle Backgrounds[/b]: Now properly fit higher screen resolutions, including those above 1920 x 1080.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332806/047402fcb250d9705c4c07238cf91cefa533f988.png[/img]

[h2]UI Improvements[/h2][list]
[*] Updated UI for “Flagging Up” feature.
[*] Added female avatar icons.
[*] The Options gear button is now fully visible.
[*] Abilities are now sorted by level in the collection menu.
[*] The last item in the Craft/Refine recipe list is now fully visible and interactable.
[*] All interfaces can now be closed with the ESC key.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332806/57749db817d4700bb8f69f1cb6a9f7861a130be5.png[/img]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*] [b]Destroyed Items Animation[/b]: Fixed the animation issue for picking up destroyed loot that wasn’t available.
[*] [b]Gather and Craft Timer[/b]: The fill-up bar now starts immediately when gathering or crafting.
[*] [b]Canceling Gathering Bug[/b]: Canceling gathering no longer prevents interaction with resources or portals.
[*] [b]World Chat Visibility[/b]: Players can now see their own and others' messages in the world chat.
[*] [b]Sigil Crafting[/b]: Resolved issues when attempting to craft Sigils.
[*] [b]Loot Collection Error[/b]: The infamous 81002 alert has been identified and resolved.
[*] [b]Keyboard Mapping[/b]: Fixed issues with remapping buttons.
[*] [b]The Houdini Bug[/b]: Characters no longer disappear when waiting for the travel-home timer to end while chatting.
[*] [b]Monsters Joining Out of Range[/b]: Monsters outside the green circle no longer join battles unexpectedly.
[*] [b]PPVE Battle Bug[/b]: Supporting players now properly respawn after a battle.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332806/f0854fe39d53780c0b23a382c73e3a12cb06b020.png[/img]


That’s all for this update! 
We hope you enjoy the new features, improved gameplay, and bug fixes. Your feedback is incredibly important to us, so don’t hesitate to share your thoughts with the team. As always, thank you for your continued support, and see you in-game!

notes.title: Dev Log #20: Exciting New Changes and Fixes!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Adventurers![/b]

We are back to it with a new dev log and [b]update[/b] details, the new version will be released on the [b]18th of July[/b]. We’re very excited to bring you the details of new features, improvements, and crucial bug fixes. Check out the detailed list of changes below:

[h3]1. Donation System: Request Specific Abilities from Your Guild Members
[/h3]
Ever wanted to upgrade a specific ability but didn't have enough level 1 versions? Great news! Ability donation between guild members is now live. Head to the Guild UI and press "donation" to start sharing and receiving abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332806/0d71aad996299d1181c9eb2b4b8323e0133c5e62.gif[/img]

[h3]2. Abilities Automatically Rewarded at the End of Battle
[/h3]
We've made awarding abilities seamless and clear. Now, abilities are automatically distributed post-battle. Sit back, watch the abilities roll in, and enjoy adding them to your deck effortlessly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332806/b66422a78faf521a2fa85d7ad237ba273a8e8009.gif[/img]

[h3]3. Adjusted Travel Back Home Fee, Teleport Fees, and Repair Costs
[/h3]
Balancing spent coins is a complex task, but we're confident we're doing better than the government handling your money! Get your gear repaired, teleport to other towns or back home with considerably lower fees.

[h3]4. Accelerated Gathering Speeds Based on Tool and Resource Tiers
[/h3]
Higher-tier tools now gather resources faster based on the tier of the resource. Gathering has never been more satisfying!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332806/c154353000e1da1a19d089a95d8ac7163a7f2acd.gif[/img]

[h3]5. Faster Mastery Level Ups
[/h3]
Level up faster than ever with our adjusted mastery points system. Show off your skills and become the Master of your favorite activity in no time.

[h3]6. Even Distribution of Resources
[/h3]
Resources now spawn in a more evenly distributed manner across the zone, reducing the frequency of resource clusters. This change ensures that players can find resources more consistently and fairly throughout their adventures.

[h3]7. Increased Coin Rewards from Higher Tier Mobs
[/h3]
We've adjusted the coin rewards, making them more abundant when defeating higher tier mobs. Now, taking on tougher enemies is more rewarding, allowing you to earn more coins for your efforts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332806/1c1823cac9b1a17906d4faab2312f54d4b3e92c1.png[/img]

[h3]8. Instant Display of Player's Own World Chat Messages
[/h3]
No more delays in seeing your own messages in the world chat. Your messages will now appear instantly, making communication smoother and more responsive.

[h3]9. No More Player Spawning in Blocked Areas
[/h3]
We've fixed the issue where players would spawn in blocked areas. You will now spawn in accessible locations, ensuring a seamless start to your journey.

[h3]10. Fixed Black Market UI 
[/h3]
The Black Market UI has been fixed! You can now find offers to buy gear from the black market system, with prices independent of the town's markets. If the price happens to be higher, you might have a chance to earn a profit.

[h3]11. Improved Guild Search Functionality
[/h3]
You can now find any guild in the guilds list with ease. The search functionality has been enhanced to ensure you can locate and join the guild you're looking for.

[h3]12. Added Gear and Bag Descriptions in Crafting Interface 
[/h3]
We've added detailed descriptions for gear and bags in the crafting interface. This addition will help you make informed decisions about what to craft, enhancing your overall crafting experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332806/664b76c3de4bbf7a6762de98df4f01f3c8d963a6.png[/img]

[h3]13. Consistent Chat Box Between Battle and Open World Scenes
[/h3]
The chat box is now consistent between battle and open world scenes. This improvement ensures a seamless communication experience, no matter where you are in the game.

[h3]14. Distinguish Between Player's and Others' Loot
[/h3]
We've made it easier to distinguish between your loot and others' loot. This clarity helps you quickly identify and collect your items without confusion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332806/94b3b6d9a29975c4900becd81020e2f73f844536.png[/img]

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. These updates aim to enhance your gaming experience, and we hope you enjoy them. 

[b]Stay Nifty, Adventurers![/b]

notes.title: Dev Update #19: Per(mission) to Boot
notes.content:
Hey everyone, while getting ready for the playtest starting tomorrow, we wanted to share some of our new additions and fixes:

[list]
[*] Crafting Boots: Now available at the Toolmaker shop. Like other gear, you can equip abilities on them, plus they have a unique ability for enhanced running.
[*] Mission System Overhaul: We've smoothed the learning curve and added crucial progression missions. Now you can select missions to follow, with recommended ones highlighted at the top.
[*] Minimap Upgrade: Enjoy aesthetic improvements and the new feature to enlarge the minimap.
[*] Area of Attack (Threat Circle): The threat circle starts small and expands based on your Overall Mastery level.
[*] Speed Adjustments: We've recalibrated the base speed to better align with future items that will affect speed and upcoming mounts.
[*] Silver Costs Adjustment: It's now easier to teleport back home and repair gear thanks to revised pricing.
[*] Zone Post Boss Rebalance: You'll have to check this one out yourself. Hint: you'll need to gather your friends.
[*] Full Bag nightmare no more: Actions such as repairing, refining, selling, crafting, and enchanting can now be performed even with a full bag.
[*] Durability Update: Gear durability is now affected by losing fights and getting knocked down.
[*] Logout Timer: Activates only on the world map.
[*] General Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed issues with Market selling, orders and prices.
[*] Fixed missing mission indicators in some instances.
[*] Fixed some UI issues.
[*] Removal of confusing recipes that appear sometimes after logging in.
[*] Fixed errors when collecting loot.
[*] Fixed disappearing runes during fusion.
[*] Fixed refining errors.
[*] Fixed issues with Repair Stations in zones.
[/list]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332806/b6c7db4aa8e3ebbd52f5b09a22c14e7cb288776a.png[/img]

notes.title: Alpha 6 playtest is acometh!
notes.content:
[h2]Alpha 6 Dates:[/h2]
🗓️ February 23, 2024 2:00 PM to February 24, 2024 9:00 PM UTC

[h2]How To Join?[/h2]
[list]
[*] If you haven’t already, head to our Steam Store page and click on “Request Access”
[*] Once the playtest starts we’ll send out emails notifying you that the game is added to your game library.
[*] Head to your library and install the game “The World of Nifty Craft Playtest”
[*] Start the FUN.
[/list]

[h2]Playtest scope:[/h2]
Just like the previous playtests, we would like the New Nifties to focus on everything from hitting play and registering your new account to abilities balance or their UI readability. If a comment appears in your mind while playing, we’d love to hear it.

For veteran playtesters, there are always improvements that are mostly happening with numbers behind the curtains, this time though, in addition to the hidden magic, you can see a major change with your own eyes 👀, The UI overhaul awaits your comments: please check the UI update notes in our [url=https://discord.gg/niftycraft]Discord server[/url] to know what to look for, and please let us know what you think about it.

notes.title: Dev Update #18
notes.content:
Hello everyone, and Happy Valentine's Day! In today's update, we're focusing on significant improvements to the user interface (UI) of The World of Nifty Craft. While we're still fine-tuning the details, I'm excited to share our progress towards a more intuitive and visually appealing design.

[h2]UI New Look:[/h2]
We've updated the look for all UIs including key sections like Inventory, Leaderboard, and Mastery. These changes aim to enhance navigation and readability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44484137/80f4216c65443f8df63e8a7bce714be11f271355.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44484137/75db0ecb117b3613d271dee6ba9b7bd15f0aa16a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44484137/ba8b5398785be22eb39767cda586f7ba25c1d1ac.png[/img]

[h2]Deck UI Overhaul:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Slot Unlock Progress:[/b] We've made the slot unlock progress and requirements more transparent, helping you understand exactly what's needed to access new slots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44484137/c983e689ede5eb11f825327d38d98a50fbbe179f.png[/img]

[*] [b]Abilities Organization:[/b] We've streamlined the Deck UI to display only Slottable Abilities, moving others to a new "Collection" tab. This should simplify the process of managing your Abilities.

[*] [b]New Tooltips:[/b] Hovering over Abilities now displays a tooltip with key information.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44484137/beab7bfae02be854034cbeb1a81950d0a1350c81.png[/img]

[*] [b]Ability Details:[/b] Clicking on an Ability now opens a detailed view that sticks around, providing information about the Ability and compatible Gear, matching this with the previous tooltip allows for quick comparisons and strategic planning.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44484137/ef7ab832f785331d08435ef27eb28bacd4715ed0.png[/img]

[*] [b]Crafting Insights:[/b] When crafting Gear, you'll now find detailed information about compatible Abilities and whether an Ability is already in your Deck or equipped, facilitating better crafting choices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44484137/2c6956e75ff3042cd6bb1460c8d7217f2b8bf784.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44484137/e690943068cf5fb6ded65f777c54d25410de35d3.png[/img]
[/list]

We're committed to improving your experience with The World of Nifty Craft and believe these UI enhancements will make the game more accessible and enjoyable. Your feedback is invaluable to us, so please share your thoughts on these changes.

[url=https://discord.gg/niftycraft]Join our Discord[/url] to keep up with our regular updates.

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update #17
notes.content:
While our team is currently busy with leveling up TWoNC's UI, they've been going at bugs like mad exterminators in the past couple of months with exceptional results, we went down from 120 to 40 reported bugs 🔥
Some of them you might have seen resolved during the January playtest, some of them were resolved afterwards.

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Crafting progress freezes and follows the character if a recipe is clicked immediately after crafting.
[*] Random lag spikes when gathering cotton.
[*] PVP loot not dropping.
[*] Corpses not showing after PVP.
[*] Newly created guilds not appearing in search results.
[*] Hotkeys remain active while using the Bug Reporting UI.
[*] Typo: "Mighties Warriors" > "Mightiest Warriors"
[*] Some hitboxes are smaller than their actual images.
[*] Some missions are completed with the wrong action.
[*] Game freezes when two non-slottable runes are fused.
[*] "Journey Home" not working in the first zone (logic issue).
[*] Rune slot incorrectly displayed in resource description UI.
[*] Incorrect coin distribution in NPC loot.
[*] Inability to select Doggy Dog, the first NPC encountered in the game.
[*] Some equipment cannot be crafted despite having the requisite mastery level.
[*] Necessity to log out and then back in to see UI changes after joining a guild.

[h2]New stuff:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a more pronounced danger feeling when health is below 20% (screen borders reddening, danger music).
[*] Refined Battle Tutorial to improve combat learning experience.
[*] Various improvements in the UI and Town for a better user interface and engagement.
[/list]

notes.title: 🌟 Dev Update #16 🔨
notes.content:
Hey Nifties! After a brief hiatus, we're back with a bug-squashing update and over 50 bug fixes, all thanks to our fantastic community and amazing Playtesters! Here’s the buzz:

[h2]🐾 [b]Mobs[/b]:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Balanced Mob difficulty for a fairer fight.
[*] Mobs now have unique behaviors and abilities. Expect the unexpected!
[/list]

[h2]🛠️[b] Questing:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Repaired some broken missions. Smooth sailing ahead!
[/list]
[h2]🔮 [b]Rune System Changes:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Tweaked Starting Rune collection for a better kick-off.
[*] Runes can now be fused directly from the equiped deck.
[*] Bag removed from Rune UI for a cleaner look.
[*] Selected Runes now display compatible gear slots.
[*] Extra Rune slots unlocked with more Overall Mastery levels.
[/list]
[h2]🎮 [b]Functional Fixes:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Monsters' hitboxes adjusted.
[*] Chatbox resize won't affect character movement.
[*] Fuse runes even when your bag is full. No more inventory headaches!
[*] Target lock-on now has a deselect option. Right-click away to change your mind!
[*] ESC key to unselect cards.
[*] Fixed crashing and error issues for smoother gameplay.
[/list]

[h2]👀 [b]Aesthetic and UX Enhancements[/b]:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Characters can blink now!
[*] Improved animations during gathering and others.
[*] UI tweaks for mission clarity and no more overlaps.
[*] Fixed typos for a polished read.
[*] Equip/unequip shortcuts for gear and moving Vault items between inventory and Vault.
[*] Slower dialogues for a comfortable reading pace.
[/list]

We’re incredibly grateful for your feedback and support. Keep it coming, and let's make The World of Nifty Craft even more awesome together! 🌍✨

Stay crafty, The Nifty Craft Team 🐾

P.S. Keep an eye out for our next announcement– we've got a playtest coming soon! 🎩🐇

[url=https://discord.com/invite/niftycraft]Join our Discord[/url]

notes.title: 🚀 Weekly Dev Update#14 : Guild Towns and World Energy🚀
notes.content:
Hey everyone We've got some beefy updates this week.

[h2]🏙️ Guild Towns:[/h2]
- Guild members can now create a portal to a new guild town on any chosen tile in a zone.
- Multiple guild towns can be established by a single guild.
- Each guild town features one portal, exclusively accessible to guild members.
-The portal construction requires resource contributions.
- Guild leaders have the authority to demolish the portal.
- Guild towns function like regular towns with unique marketplaces, land plots, crafting stations, vaults, and other buildings.
-They provide a dedicated, guild-exclusive space for collaborative gameplay and resource management.
- Guild towns consume nutrition daily, with a maximum cap.
- Nutrition maintenance is the responsibility of guild members.
- A zero nutrition level restricts access to the town, except for the guild leader.

[h2]⚡ World Energy:[/h2]
- A new resource, World Energy, is introduced.
- Guild members contribute World Energy to their guild town.
- The cumulative World Energy in a town determines its maximum nutrition cap.
- This energy is also consumed daily, influencing the town's operational capacity.

Join our discord server for real-time updates and endless fun! https://bit.ly/3Ragg0R

notes.title: 🚀 Monday Update on The World of Nifty Craft - Version 0.1.23.3
notes.content:
[b]🏡 Land Plots Auctions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Each capital town (Zyzantium, Mithrus, Etruria, Pontus) offers 20 land plots.
[*] Players can bid for these plots through a 7-day auction, recurring every 30 days.
[*] Bids involve silver, which is locked in escrow during the auction.
[*] Owners can accept or reject the highest bid within the auction period or an additional transfer day.
[*] Automatic transfer to the highest bidder occurs if the owner doesn't actively respond by the end of the transfer period.
[*] A mail system notifies players at key auction stages.
[/list]

[b]🛒 Crafting Stations:[/b]
[list]
[*] Landowners can build one of five types of crafting stations per plot.
[*] Stations require resources for construction and can be demolished for partial resource recovery.
[*] Station types: Toolmaker, Refinery, Warrior Forge, Hunter Lodge, Mage Tower.
[*] Each station type supports unique recipes, scalable up to 8 tiers.
[/list]

[b]😋 Figs:[/b]
[list]
[*] Introduction of "nutrition" currency that the landowner needs to deposit to allow crafting by customers.
[*] Nutrition costs vary by recipe and are supplied by depositing Figs, each containing 100 nutrition.
[*] Owners set silver charges per unit of nutrition.
[*] Insufficient nutrition at a station prevents crafting by customers.
[*] Figs, a key resource, will initially be available as NPC loot drops.
[/list]

[olist]

[*] A notification from Steam will pop up in your notifications on 26th October.

Your insights are the lifeblood of our development process. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please report them through our in-game feedback system. Alternatively, join our [url=https://discord.gg/niftycraft]Discord community[/url] for real-time discussions and support.
